{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D1","page":1,"quote":"13 (-0.2/-0.1)"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"ELECTOLESS NICKEL PLATING"}],"comment":"Dimension D1 carries a tolerance band of 0.1 mm on a part that is electroless nickel plated, but the drawing does not state whether the dimension is before or after plating. Plating buildup can push the finished size out of tolerance and cause assembly interference. The designer should add a note specifying whether the 13 mm dimension applies before or after plating, or adjust the tolerance to account for the coating thickness."
  , "recommended_correction": "Add a note clarifying if the dimension is pre- or post-plating, or widen/shift the tolerance to accommodate the plating thickness."}]}
